entities.name: C2 authorization procedure
entities.description: Procedure for authorizing C2 communication between UAV and UAV-C, requiring successful USS authorization before enabling user plane connectivity.

entities.name: UUAA-SM procedure
entities.description: UAS Unmanned Aerial System Authentication and Authorization Service Management procedure used to authorize C2 communication during PDU session establishment or modification.

entities.name: PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure to establish a PDU session, during which UUAA-SM can be performed for C2 communication authorization.

entities.name: PDU session modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure to modify an existing PDU session, during which UUAA-SM can be performed for C2 communication authorization.

entities.name: CAA-level UAV ID
entities.description: Identifier provided by UE to the network for C2 authorization procedure, representing the UAV identity at Civil Aviation Authority level.

entities.name: Application layer payload
entities.description: Payload containing information for UAV-C pairing and UAV flight authorization, provided by upper layers during C2 authorization procedure.

entities.name: UAV and UAV-C pairing
entities.description: Condition requiring successful USS authorization before C2 communication user plane connectivity can be enabled.

entities.name: Pairing revocation
entities.description: Condition where UAV and UAV-C pairing is revoked, leading to disabling of C2 communication.

entities.name: C2 communication disabled
entities.description: Property where network disables C2 communication, either by removing QoS flow during PDU session modification or releasing PDU session.

relations.description: C2 authorization procedure requires successful UAV and UAV-C pairing authorization by USS.
C2 authorization procedure includes CAA-level UAV ID provided by UE.
C2 authorization procedure may include application layer payload with UAV-C pairing and flight authorization information.
PDU session establishment procedure may include UUAA-SM procedure for C2 communication authorization.
PDU session modification procedure may include UUAA-SM procedure for C2 communication authorization.
Pairing revocation condition leads to C2 communication being disabled by the network.
